sodass.es: de modo que, de manera que

bloques.titulo: Active process of transformation against completed work
texto: 1. **Vorgangspassiv (werden + Partizip II)**: Describes that the work is in progress (**Die Straße wird asphaltiert**: the street is being paved). It is usually accompanied by temporary adverbs such as **gerade, zurzeit, gegenwärtig**.
2. **Zustandspassiv (sein + Partizip II)**: Note that the work is finished and the space is available (**Die Straße ist asphaltiert**: the street is paved).

filas: Die Brücke wird repariert. (obras en curso)
Die Straße wird freigegeben. (acto de abrir)

frases.de: Das alte Gebäude am Bahnhof wird seit zwei Monaten repariert.
frases.es: El viejo edificio junto a la estación está siendo reparado desde hace dos meses.
frases.en: The old building next to the station has been repaired for two months.
analisis: is being repaired for two months

frases.de: Der Asphalt auf der Hauptstraße ist bereits erneuert und für den Verkehr freigegeben.
frases.es: El asfalto de la calle principal ya está renovado y abierto al tráfico.
frases.en: The main street asphalt is already renovated and open to traffic.

frases.de: Gegenwärtig werden die neuen Schienen für die Straßenbahn verlegt.
frases.es: Actualmente se están tendiendo los nuevos raíles para el tranvía.
frases.en: The new rails for the tram are currently being set.

frases.de: Der Gehweg ist fertiggestellt, sodass Fußgänger die Straße sicher überqueren können.
frases.es: La acera está terminada, de modo que los peatones pueden cruzar la calle con seguridad.
frases.en: The sidewalk is finished, so pedestrians can safely cross the street.

bloques.pregunta: What does the «Der Asphalt ist für den Verkehr freigegeben» phrase report?

opciones.texto: That vehicles can already move freely on the street.
opciones.explicacion: «ist freigegeben» communicates the open and available state of the road.

opciones.texto: That the machines are removing the damaged asphalt now.
opciones.explicacion: That would be a pre-process («wird erneuert»).

opciones.texto: That the city council will ban the passage of cars next week.
opciones.explicacion: It does not announce a future closure, but the current opening to traffic.

bloques.frase: Gegenwärtig ___ neue Leitungen unter dem Gehweg verlegt.

opciones.explicacion: The «gegenwärtig» warning and the «Leitungen» plural point to passive process with «werden».
«sind verlegt» would indicate that the installation has already been completed.
It would express a previous past state, not a contemporary process.

bloques.frase: Das alte Gebäude am Bahnhof wird repariert.

opciones.texto: That the workers are doing repair work in the building.
opciones.explicacion: Process liability: the action of repair is developing.

opciones.texto: That the building is already fully fixed and open.
opciones.explicacion: The completed work would be expressed with «ist repariert».

opciones.texto: That the building has been definitely demolished by the municipality.
opciones.explicacion: The verb «reparieren» means fix, not demolish.

bloques.pregunta: If a technician says «Das Gebäude ist gesichert», what do you mean?

opciones.texto: To the protected and safe state in which the property is left.
opciones.explicacion: It is a Zustandspassiv that describes the resulting condition.

opciones.texto: A security team is watching the doors live.
opciones.explicacion: It describes the condition of the building, not a time-bound live action.

opciones.texto: The building's construction work has just begun.
opciones.explicacion: Safety as a result presupposes actions already implemented.

bloques.frase: Nach monatelanger Arbeit ___ die neue Sporthalle endlich fertiggestellt.

opciones.explicacion: «ist fertiggestellt» notes the final state of completion of the work.
With «endlich» and after months of work, the final state is emphasized.
«wurde fertiggestellt» would focus on the time event of completion in the past.

bloques.pregunta: What happens according to this sentence?
bloques.frase: Die Schienen für die Straßenbahn werden gerade verlegt.

opciones.texto: The tram rails are being installed at this very moment.
opciones.explicacion: «werden gerade verlegt» marks process in rigorous development.

opciones.texto: The tram rails have been dismounted for lack of use.
opciones.explicacion: This is a new installation, not a disassembly.

opciones.texto: The tram service already works normally on the track.
opciones.explicacion: The rails are still being placed; the line is not operational.

bloques.frase: der Gehweg ist für alle Fußgänger freigegeben
bloques.traduccion: the sidewalk is enabled for all pedestrians

intro: We are in a rigorous way in contrast to the situation resulting from urban and public works reports.
